market_summary: US equities swung between losses and gains amid elevated Treasury yields following hotter-than-expected October CPI data. The S&P 500 fell 0.38% to 7,520.93 on Tuesday, while Nasdaq dropped 0.74% to 25,065.87 amid Nvidia weakness. Wednesday saw a rebound with S&P 500 futures up 0.70% and Nasdaq-100 up 1.60%, driven by tech strength including CoreWeave's earnings beat. Singapore banks delivered mixed Q3 results with OCBC beating forecasts while DBS and UOB missed; the Straits Times Index ended down 2.2% for the week. Singapore Airlines reported strong Q2 operating profit but H1 net profit declined 43.9% due to elevated jet fuel costs from the Middle East conflict.

items.headline: Baird downgrades Nvidia to Neutral, slashes price target to $200
items.summary: <cite index="1-1">Baird downgraded Nvidia stock to Neutral and more than halved its price target to $200 from $500, citing lack of visibility into 2027 data center demand, mostly tied to supply constraints, and uncertainty over U.S. government action and CEO tenure.</cite> <cite index="6-3">Morgan Stanley analyst removed Nvidia as a Top Pick following the bank's stop-loss policy due to a 25% decline since Oct. 2 designation.</cite>

items.headline: Nvidia faces scrutiny over CEO's reported relationship with Singapore-based executive
items.summary: <cite index="6-5">Nvidia shares fell sharply following reports that CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with Alice Huang, an executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed, which U.S. intelligence agencies say has been passing information to Beijing.</cite>

items.headline: OCBC beats Q3 2026 earnings estimates with S$2.04 billion net profit
items.summary: <cite index="24-1,24-5">OCBC reported Q3 2026 net profit of S$2.04 billion — up 3.2% year-on-year and slightly above the analyst consensus of S$2.01 billion, standing out as the only Singapore bank to beat estimates.</cite> <cite index="25-2">OCBC's net profit for the first nine months of 2026 reached a record S$6.24 billion, up 10% from the same period a year earlier.</cite>

items.headline: DBS Q3 2026 net profit falls 5% to S$2.81 billion, misses forecasts
items.summary: <cite index="20-1,20-2">DBS net profit was down 5% to $2.81 billion, with markets trading income plunging 65% to $152 million.</cite> <cite index="24-7">DBS's performance missed analyst expectations of around S$2.90 billion.</cite>

items.headline: UOB Q3 2026 profit surges 182% but misses consensus forecasts
items.summary: <cite index="22-2,22-4">UOB net profit of S$1.25 billion is 182.2% above Q3 2025's S$443 million.</cite> <cite index="23-6">UOB's Q3 2026 profit of S$1.25 billion was down 15% quarter-on-quarter and missed the S$1.38 billion consensus by a wide margin.</cite> <cite index="22-7">UOB shares fell approximately 5% after the Q3 2026 results were released on 4 November 2026.</cite>

items.headline: Singapore Airlines Q2 net profit quadruples to S$209.7 million on strong travel demand
items.summary: <cite index="14-1,14-4">Net income quadrupled to S$210 million ($164 million) in the three months ended Sept. 30. Revenue climbed 14% to S$5.6 billion on a combination of higher fares, resilient passenger demand and a strong pickup in air cargo volumes driven by the AI boom.</cite>

items.headline: Singapore Airlines H1 FY2026/27 net profit falls 43.9% to S$134 million on higher fuel costs
items.summary: <cite index="13-4,13-3">Singapore Airlines Group's net profit declined by 43.9 per cent to S$134 million during the first half of financial year 2026/27, from S$239 million in the preceding year, amid elevated jet fuel prices due to the West Asia conflict. Revenue increased by 16.8% to S$11.29 billion, driven by record passenger numbers and strong growth in passenger and cargo yields.</cite>

items.headline: Keppel to pay special dividends from asset monetisation proceeds
items.summary: <cite index="37-2,37-6">Keppel Ltd aims to pay out 10% to 15% of realised proceeds from its asset monetisation programme as special dividends for FY2026, but has not declared a special dividend yet.</cite> <cite index="37-7,37-8">So far this year, Keppel has completed and realised about S$940 million of asset monetisation and targets about S$600 million more by end-2026 from its first six legacy rigs.</cite>

items.headline: US market futures rally on tech rebound despite higher Treasury yields
items.summary: <cite index="31-1,31-3">U.S. stock futures rose on Wednesday, as the Dow Jones, S&P 500, and Nasdaq 100 indices advanced, with S&P 500 up 0.70% and Nasdaq 100 up 1.60%, following Tuesday's lower close.</cite> <cite index="29-4">Tech & AI stocks including Nvidia, Micron Technology, AMD, Intel, Alphabet, Broadcom, and Meta Platforms traded higher during pre-market hours.

items.headline: S&P 500 and Nasdaq decline as hotter-than-expected CPI raises rate-hike expectations
items.summary: <cite index="30-8,30-11">The S&P 500 fell 0.38% to close at 7,520.93 and the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.74% to close at 25,065.87 for its first negative session in three.</cite> <cite index="35-1,35-6">October prices rose 0.4%, not the 0.3% economists expected, and core prices rose 0.3% against 0.2%.</cite>
